summary.text: Linda Massimilla is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Grafton 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race where three seats are filled.
She previously represented Grafton 1 in the House from December 2012 to December 2024.

paragraphs.text: Linda Massimilla assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, representing Grafton 1, on December 5, 2012, and left office on December 4, 2024.
Throughout her tenure she was assigned to the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee, and she served as its vice chair in the 2019-2020 session.
In the November 2024 general election she received 2,755 votes and was not among the three winners in Grafton 1.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, along with Timothy Egan and Joseph Beaulieu.
